title: index_shape
description: The shape classifier's answer for one plot index entry (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 77): the data shape the chart type draws, one of eight, and its canonical chart type, null for a page that is not a chart type for research data (data_shape none).

data_shape.description: dist: one numeric variable over groups; xy: two numeric variables per observation; series: a value along an ordered x; category: one value per category; whole: parts of a whole; matrix: a value per pair of categories; multivar: rows of many variables; none: not a chart type for research data

canonical_chart_type.description: the chart type in a few plain words, shared by every page that draws it (density, box with points, grouped bar)

reason.description: one sentence on what in the page decided it
